record.paper_title: Recent progress and open questions on the numerical index of Banach spaces
record.original_question: Suppose X is a Banach space with numerical index 1. Must every extreme point x of the unit ball B_X and every extreme point x* of the dual unit ball B_{X*} satisfy |x*(x)| = 1?

evidence.quote: Problem 12. Let X be a Banach space with numerical index 1. Is it true that |x∗(x)| = 1 for every x∗ ∈ ext(BX∗ ) and every x ∈ ext(BX )?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a real or complex Banach space, with closed unit ball B_X and topological dual X*. The numerical radius of a bounded linear operator T: X → X is defined by
  v(T) = sup{ |x*(T x)| : x ∈ B_X, x* ∈ B_{X*}, x*(x) = 1 },
and the numerical index of X is
  n(X) = inf{ v(T) : T ∈ L(X), ‖T‖ = 1 }.
Assume that n(X) = 1; equivalently, v(T) = ‖T‖ for every bounded linear operator T on X.

Let ext(B_X) denote the set of extreme points of B_X and ext(B_{X*}) the set of extreme points of B_{X*}. 

Question: Must it be true that |x*(x)| = 1 for every x ∈ ext(B_X) and every x* ∈ ext(B_{X*})?
artifact.status_search_result: Web search did not turn up a definitive resolution. The question is a known McGregor-type problem; in finite dimensions McGregor's theorem gives the affirmative answer, and recent work on lush spaces and characterizations of numerical index one (e.g., Kadets–Martín–Merí and follow-ups) extends partial results, but an infinite-dimensional characterization via this extreme-point condition is described in recent literature as still elusive. No source clearly proves or disproves the full statement.

status_evidence.title: A characterization of Banach spaces with numerical index one
status_evidence.snippet: an infinite-dimensional extension of McGregor's characterization remains elusive
status_evidence.claim: Recent work indicates the infinite-dimensional extreme-point characterization of numerical index 1 is still not established.

status_evidence.title: Historical Introduction: A Walk on the Results for Banach Spaces with Numerical Index 1
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of results on Banach spaces with numerical index 1, including McGregor's finite-dimensional characterization and subsequent partial extensions.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is documented as part of a body of open questions surrounding McGregor-type characterizations.
